description: Decodes the QR code in an image and returns the text it holds.

format.description: How `image` is given: `url` for a link, `base64` for the image bytes.

image.description: A link to the image, or the base64-encoded image bytes when format is `base64`.

name: read_qr_code

content.description: The text encoded in the QR code, or an error message for non-200 statuses.

title: Read a QR code
